task.title: Synthesize independently checked approved SASA
task.goal: After the HARD sasa dependency is approved, read approved sasa.json and the frozen source, independently verify provenance, counts and residue sum, and deliver synthesis with summary, total_A2, source_sha256, upstream_sha256 and complete executed code under the exact synthesis resultSchema in alignmentMarkdown. The result describes one fixed structure without biological function ranking.
task.boundary: Assigned only to the non-captain Codex member. Scientific inputs are the approved SASA artifact and frozen source; workflow context and bound review evidence are used only for contract/provenance validation. No unapproved pilot, new structures, refetch, installs, biological/clinical inference, or upstream code execution solely for provenance. Captain independently reviews.
acceptance: Enforce HARD dependency sasa: consume only APPROVED sasa.json with approval bound to its reviewedArtifact; no synthesis from the first pilot or request_changes artifact. Hash UTF-8 reviewFileUtf8 against reviewArtifact, parse original review envelope, verify approve verdict and captain member reviewer identity, and verify its receipt against actual sasa.json bytes.

Independently hash actual approved upstream envelope bytes for upstream_sha256 (64 hex characters), and actual frozen PDB bytes for source_sha256=42199a30a0701864a2a5cc76cd7f35cc544cd0e65fbcf63e03c166543249b811. Validate source identity without comparing nested producer/reviewer context receipts to current context.json; own inputReceipts hash only this attempt attachments.

Independently recount 327 retained heavy chain-A ATOM records and 46 residues 1..46 under frozen filters; independently sum all 46 measured residue areas and compare to approved total_A2 within 0.001 A2, reporting the measured sum and difference. Deliver total_A2 as the independently computed sum and do not modify upstream data.

Deliver summary (at least 30 characters), numeric total_A2 in A2, source_sha256, upstream_sha256 and code with exact types under unchanged synthesis schema. Include complete portable actually executed Python source, actual tool versions in code comments or summary, and concrete count/sum/hash evidence rather than filenames alone.

Summary explicitly states single fixed structure, computational geometry only, no biological function ranking or clinical inference; retain the approved calculation resolution/convergence and its limitations without claiming structural ensemble or experimental validation.

Captain reviewerAgentId=member_node-4050b257-1656-4536-aaff-faff95fd7973 independently recomputes source counts, residue sums and source/upstream hashes, validates approval binding and the unchanged schema, and documents numeric reproduction evidence before approving; scientific checks and execution success remain distinct.

Use only available local tools and relative input paths; no installs, network refetch, unrelated files, or sensitive public details. Report missing/invalid approval or inputs rather than fabricate; stop after the required synthesis envelope exists.

executionHistory.limitation: Host-accepted lifecycle receipts from the assigned member connector. Not an independent provider audit, a full tool transcript, or proof of scientific correctness. Raw reply text is private; its SHA256 is recorded when available.

acceptance: Read and hash the exact frozen source-1CRN.pdb; source_sha256 must equal 42199a30a0701864a2a5cc76cd7f35cc544cd0e65fbcf63e03c166543249b811. Apply chain A, heavy ATOM, alternate location blank/A, no HETATM/hydrogen filters; independently confirm atom_count=327, residue_count=46, and unique residue_id values 1..46.

Actually execute Bio.PDB.SASA.ShrakeRupley with probe_radius_A=1.4 and radii C=1.70, N=1.55, O=1.52, S=1.80 Angstrom; method must be Shrake-Rupley; total_A2 and per-residue area_A2 are computed square-Angstrom values, not copied references.

On FIRST attempt, before SASA computation use an actual ask-user/question tool to request the verification phrase and wait for a real answer in NEEDS_INPUT. After receiving it, execute ONLY n_points=100, label exploratory, submit the truthful deliberately incomplete pilot, and receive request_changes; missing tool/answer must be reported without invention.

On REWORK with previous-sasa.json and feedback, do not ask again; actually run n_points=1000 and 5000. Deliver final n_points>=1000, both measured totals, abs(total_1000-total_5000)/abs(total_5000)<=0.02 with denominator stated, consistent top-level resolution, retained pilot evidence and a numerical/structural limitation. A missing comparison or 100-point-only output fails final acceptance.

Deliver every required field with exact types under the unchanged sasa schema: 46 residue objects, integer residue_id, nonnegative numeric area_A2 and total_A2, integer n_points, complete portable actually executed Python code and actual tool_versions; include units, radii, run settings and execution evidence. Use relative paths and no sensitive public details.

Pass frozen scientificChecks version 1: abs(total_A2-sum(residues[*].area_A2))<=0.001 A2 and residue_count=46 exactly. Schema validity, execution success, these checks and scientific approval must be distinguished; do not alter observations or frozen rules to force a pass.

Captain reviewerAgentId=member_node-4050b257-1656-4536-aaff-faff95fd7973 independently executes a standard-Python or available-NumPy baseline from the actual source, checks counts/sums/hashes/settings, and reports numeric baseline comparisons and reproducible evidence in reproduction. Pilot must receive request_changes even if correct; final approval requires all final criteria.

Use only actually available tools, no installs or network refetch, and include own-run original input receipts. Hand off exact sasa.json only after captain approval with bound Host-validated approval evidence; report unavailable prerequisites, and stop once the required attempt envelope exists.
